nodes.label: Running the Campaign — GM Philosophy
nodes.rationale: GM guide covering OGAS system, Three-Clue Rule, Moral Dilemma Engine, consequence tracking, format adaptations, tone calibration

nodes.label: OGAS System
nodes.rationale: NPC framework: Occupation/Goal/Attitude/Secret. Applied to all key NPCs. At-table heuristic: what they want + what they won't say

nodes.label: Three-Clue Rule
nodes.rationale: Every important discovery has at least three separate paths. No single failure walls off story. Built into all session guides

nodes.label: Moral Dilemma Engine
nodes.rationale: Five session dilemmas with no text answers, only consequences. End-of-session direct question to players. Hesitaters doing most interesting work

nodes.label: Consequence Tracking
nodes.rationale: Track who knows what, relationship states, Dawnborn positions, Living World state. Information asymmetry is campaign engine

nodes.label: Tone Calibration (3 Levels)
nodes.rationale: Level 1 Low Tragedy, Level 2 Standard, Level 3 High Tragedy. Affects food store %, Edoran's grief recency, Dawnborn decline visibility

nodes.label: GM Character Interview Framework
nodes.rationale: 10-question pre-session-0 interview. Extracts player want/fear/lie without asking directly. Most important: what they won't do even if right

nodes.label: Living World System
nodes.rationale: Grey sickness rate, food supply, political pressure create texture not countdown. Players feel city worsening in real time. Rules in GM Toolkit
